# Software Engineer Program Internship

Our multi-billion-dollar annual investment in technology makes us one of the largest tech companies in the world. You’ll work in an open, collaborative, and supportive culture, where our agile teams are constantly innovating, learning new skills, and at the forefront of developing new technologies and solutions.

With the scale of our business, you could impact [](https://www.jpmorganchase.com/careers/explore-opportunities/programs/software-engineer-summer)millions of consumers, thousands of enterprise clients, and [](https://www.jpmorganchase.com/careers/explore-opportunities/programs/software-engineer-summer)300,000+ employees. We’re committed to advancing your career: helping you acquire new skills, opportunities, and a global network of support that will help you take your career in any direction imaginable.

[Apply now](https://www.jpmorganchase.com/careers/explore-opportunities/programs/software-engineer-summer#first-apply-now-link)

## Inside the program

### What you'll do

As a Software Engineer Summer Intern, you’ll be embedded on an agile engineering team in one of our technology lines of business where you’ll help design, build, test, and enhance digital applications and platforms that support millions of customers, clients, and employees around the world.

You’ll work alongside experienced software engineers to solve real‑world problems—whether that’s improving payment experiences, enhancing trading systems, automating processes, or strengthening platform reliability. Our technology teams are AI‑enabled, and you’ll use our internal AI tools as part of your day‑to‑day work to support development activities, enhancing productivity and code quality.

In addition to your core team project, you’ll collaborate with interns from other functions on a cross‑disciplinary project that supports our community partners. This experience gives you exposure to how different roles come together to deliver impact beyond the firm.

Throughout the summer, you’ll contribute code, share ideas, and see the results of your work in production or pilot environments—adding value from the start.

### Who we're looking for

We're looking for curious, collaborative problem solvers who are eager to build, improve, and deliver technology that creates real world impact. Ideal candidates bring foundational skills in at least one programming language, and an understanding of software skills such as business analysis, development, maintenance, and software improvement — along with an understanding of how software components work together. Experience developing with AI tools, including the ability to validate and refine AI-generated outputs with sound judgment, will set you apart. Exposure to agile methodologies, secure coding practices, and technologies like cloud computing, AI/ML, or mobile development is a plus.

### What we offer

Our summer internship is designed to help you grow as both a technologist and a professional while gaining a realistic view of what it’s like to build technology at scale.

You’ll begin with a firmwide orientation and technology induction to learn about our businesses, engineering practices, and development methodologies while building core professional skills, followed by ongoing technical and professional training in areas such as cybersecurity, effective communication, and the responsible use of AI in software engineering.

You’ll be fully integrated into our global technology community and supported throughout the program through:

*   A dedicated peer mentor (a junior software engineer) to help you make the most of your experience
*   Global and local senior speaker sessions to learn from leaders
*   Time and encouragement to network and shadow colleagues to expand your perspective

For top performers, the internship can be a pathway to a full‑time role through our Software Engineer Program or a return internship, depending on graduation date.

## Our opportunities

### Full-Stack Developer

Work across the entire software stack — from user interfaces to databases — building solutions that are resilient, scalable, and ready for cloud, mobile, and on-premises environments. You'll design features with observability baked in, integrate AI/ML-powered experiences, and use modern tech stacks like Python, Java, React, Node.js, Docker, and Kubernetes alongside AI-assisted development tools to ship quality code faster.

Sample projects you might work on:

*   Build cloud-native payment services processing millions of transactions per second with secure APIs and real-time risk controls.
*   Create a Python-based AI agent with a React front end that streams cited answers and automates multi-step workflows through secure API calls.

### Back-end Developer

Focus on the server-side logic that powers our applications — building the web services, APIs, and integrations that front-end and mobile developers rely on. You'll design microservices, work with databases and messaging layers like Kafka, implement secure authentication, and build agentic services for AI-powered tool calling — all while applying modern cybersecurity standards, secure-by-default engineering practices, and AI-assisted development tools.

Sample projects you might work on:

*   Build a best-in-class electronic trading platform for Rates and Emerging Markets business lines in the Investment Bank.
*   Develop an agentic AI matching capability that connects issuers with investors — ingesting needs and mandates, autonomously gathering relevant data, and producing explainable ranked recommendations via modern APIs.

### Front-end Developer

Shape how users interact with our products — building websites, web applications, and mobile experiences that are intuitive, accessible, and secure. You'll create AI-powered interfaces like chat assistants with streaming responses and citations, contribute to design systems and accessibility standards, implement secure authentication, and use modern frameworks like React, Swift, and Kotlin alongside AI-assisted development tools to deliver polished experiences faster.

Sample projects you might work on:

*   Design innovative, enterprise-level customer-facing experiences for the bank's commercial clients using React.
*   Build responsive web and Android applications for retail branch bankers to accelerate digital adoption and deliver a seamless customer experience.

### Cybersecurity Developer

Protect our people, clients, and assets by engineering security solutions with cutting-edge technology. You'll build tooling across software, endpoint, network, and data security — including securing AI-enabled applications against threats like prompt injection and data leakage. You will use AI-assisted development tools and evaluate new technologies to strengthen the bank's cyber defense capabilities.

Sample projects you might work on:

*   Develop complex platforms deployed in public and private cloud environments to meet the bank's evolving cyber defense needs
*   Implement an attack simulation tool and integrate it into our vulnerability management ecosystem

### Infrastructure Developer

Build and operate the large-scale infrastructure and cloud platforms that power the firm's most critical businesses. Using AI-assisted development tools, you'll develop Infrastructure as Code solutions, CI/CD systems, and private cloud infrastructure — while enabling secure integration with public cloud providers like AWS, Azure, and GCP, including connectivity for AI/ML services.

Sample projects you might work on:

*   Engineer solutions to enhance infrastructure services such as Virtual Machines and Storage that run applications across JPMorganChase’s diverse businesses
*   Develop modern private cloud storage platforms to serve all consumers of storage infrastructure at the firm.

### Site Reliability Engineer

Apply a software engineering mindset to keep our applications and infrastructure available, reliable, and performant. You'll use observability tools to detect and diagnose issues, partner with development teams to implement consistent monitoring and alerting standards, and leverage and leverage AIOps and LLM capabilities to automate incident response and operational workflows — reducing the time it takes to resolve incidents.

Sample projects you might work on:

*   Develop software automation and stability tools built around a Big Data reservoir system to improve the production support experience.
*   Build resilience and stability tooling to accelerate adoption of native cloud technologies and enhance the customer experience.

***Join the Pioneer Crypto Brand in the Philippines!***

Coins is the most established crypto brand in The Philippines and has gained the trust of more than 18 million users. Through the easy-to-use mobile app, users can buy and sell a variety of different cryptocurrencies and access a wide range of financial services.

Coins is fully regulated by the Bangko Sentral ng Pilipinas (BSP) and is the first ever crypto-based company in Asia to hold both Virtual Currency and Electronic Money Issuer licenses from a central bank.

We're looking for a **Backend Engineer** who wants to grow their career building payment systems used by millions. You'll work with senior engineers and architects in a regional team, and you'll use AI tools every day to build, test, and ship faster.

#### What You'll Do

* **Build and ship backend services:** Design, develop, test, and maintain Java-based microservices that run our payment platform. Contribute to features across the payment lifecycle, including acquiring, clearing, settlement, and ledger accounting.
* **Protect user funds:** Help build and improve reconciliation jobs, exception-handling flows, and monitoring that keep every transaction accurate and every peso accounted for.
* **Integrate with partners:** Work on integrations with banks, local payment methods, card networks, and international payment partners. Along the way you'll learn how multi-currency and FX flows work.
* **Use AI in your daily work:** Use AI-assisted development tools (e.g., code assistants, AI-driven testing, and debugging) to work more productively. Help explore and prototype AI-powered features and internal tools.
* **Improve reliability and performance:** Troubleshoot production issues, write clean and well-tested code, and help make our systems more available, scalable, and efficient.
* **Collaborate across teams and regions:** Work closely with product, risk, finance, and compliance, as well as Mandarin-speaking engineering and business teams, to deliver secure and compliant solutions.

#### What We're Looking For

* 1–5 years of professional backend development experience. Strong fresh graduates with solid internship or project experience are welcome to apply.
* Hands-on experience with **Java** (Spring Boot preferred). Experience in other backend languages is a plus if you're willing to work mainly in Java.
* Familiarity with **microservices architecture**, RESTful APIs, and relational databases (e.g., MySQL, PostgreSQL).
* A **strong interest in AI**, such as regularly using AI coding tools, experimenting with LLMs or AI APIs, or building AI-powered side projects.
* **Proficiency in Mandarin Chinese** (spoken and written) is required. You'll work regularly with Mandarin-speaking teams and stakeholders. Business-level English is also required.
* A good grasp of computer science fundamentals: data structures, algorithms, and basic distributed systems concepts.
* Strong problem-solving skills, ownership, and eagerness to learn.

#### Nice To Have

* Exposure to fintech, payments, banking, e-wallets, or crypto.
* Experience with message queues (e.g., Kafka, RabbitMQ), caching (e.g., Redis), or containerization (Docker, Kubernetes).
* Understanding of transaction consistency, idempotency, or reconciliation concepts.
* Experience with cloud platforms (AWS, GCP, or Alibaba Cloud).

### Overview

Software engineers are some of the most sought-after and highly-compensated professionals in today’s global economy. From tech startups to governments and global financial institutions, every organization and company needs the skills of a developer. Software engineering internships ensure students, graduates, and career-changers alike are prepared to succeed in this competitive field.

We place interns in an incredibly diverse array of organizations, and they take on roles ranging from video game development to website design. Each placement is unique and immersive. Interns learn from some of the top software engineers in the world, and gain a truly global perspective on the field.

One of the most valuable outcomes of a software engineering internship is the portfolio of work interns compile. This concrete evidence of hands-on experience and strong technical skills is extremely influential when it comes time to find a full-time role.

### Why choose this industry

Software engineering combines programming, problem-solving, creativity and collaboration to build technology that people and organisations use every day.

An internship gives you the opportunity to experience the software development lifecycle in a professional setting. You could contribute to planning a new feature, writing and reviewing code, testing an application, fixing bugs or helping deploy a finished product.

You'll also gain experience with the collaborative side of software engineering. Professional development teams often work across engineering, product, design, marketing, data and business functions, making communication and teamwork just as important as technical ability.

Technology is also constantly evolving. Software engineers increasingly work alongside technologies such as artificial intelligence, machine learning, cloud computing and automation. An internship can help you understand how these technologies are incorporated into real products and business processes.

### Responsibilities

Software engineering interns on our international internship program may contribute to projects such as:

* Writing, testing and maintaining software code
* Developing websites and web applications
* Building front-end user interfaces
* Supporting back-end application development
* Working across the full software stack
* Developing and integrating APIs
* Debugging applications and resolving technical issues
* Participating in code reviews
* Writing automated tests and supporting quality assurance
* Working with databases and data systems
* Supporting cloud-based applications and infrastructure
* Assisting with software deployment and DevOps processes
* Developing internal tools and automation
* Researching and evaluating new technologies
* Creating technical documentation
* Collaborating with designers, product managers and other developers

Throughout your internship, you'll work alongside experienced technology professionals while developing your programming, analytical, problem-solving and communication skills.

### Typical roles

Every internship placement is tailored to your interests, experience and host organisation. Previous interns have contributed to a wide range of software engineering projects in roles such as:

### Available destinations

Software Engineering is a global profession, with technology companies and digital teams operating across industries and around the world. Depending on your program, you can complete an international software engineering internship in:

### Program options

### In-person software engineering internships

Gain hands-on experience through an in-person software engineering internship abroad. Work alongside your host organisation's development or technology team, contribute to real projects and experience working in an international professional environment.

### Blended software engineering internships

Combine international experience with the flexibility of remote work through our blended internship program. Begin your experience abroad before continuing remotely, allowing you to remain involved with your host organisation and continue developing your technical skills.

### Remote software engineering internships

Gain real-world software engineering experience from wherever you are through a remote internship. Collaborate with international development teams, contribute to technical projects and build your portfolio while working remotely.

### Digital Nomad software engineering internships

Combine professional development and international travel through our digital nomad internship program. Work remotely while experiencing a new destination and gaining valuable experience in the global technology industry.

**A World-Changing Company**

Palantir builds the world’s leading software for data-driven decisions and operations. By bringing the right data to the people who need it, our platforms empower our partners to develop lifesaving drugs, forecast supply chain disruptions, locate missing children, and more.

**The Role**

Software Engineers at Palantir build software at scale to transform how organizations around the world use data. As a Software Engineer Intern, you’ll have an opportunity to grow more quickly than you ever envisioned, as you contribute high-quality code directly to Palantir Gotham, Palantir Foundry, or Palantir Apollo: products that are deployed at some of the most important institutions across the public and private sectors. You'll create features used by research scientists, aerospace engineers, intelligence analysts, and economic forecasters, in countries around the world. Palantir's Product Development organization is made up of small teams of Software Engineers, each focusing on a specific aspect of a product. For example, you might join a team that builds a Foundry front-end application, or a component of the Gotham release infrastructure. We encourage communication and collaboration among teams to share context, skills, and experience, so you'll learn about many different aspects of each product.

**Core Responsibilities**

As a Software Engineer, you are involved throughout the product lifecycle - from idea generation, design, and prototyping to execution and shipping while also being paired with a mentor dedicated to your growth and success. You'll collaborate closely with technical and non-technical counterparts to understand our customers' problems and build products that tackle them. One of the most effective ways to understand what our users need is to meet them. You may receive an opportunity to tour the assembly line at an auto-manufacturer or join a counter-terror analyst at their desk to really understand their mission and difficulties.

**SWE principles include:**

• Ownership: We see projects through from beginning to end in spite of obstacles we may encounter.

• Collaboration: We work internally with people from a variety of backgrounds — such as other Software Engineers, Product Managers, Designers and Product Reliability Engineers. We also partner with our business development teams (Forward Deployed Engineers, Deployment Strategists) in order to understand and solve our customers' problems.

• Trust: We trust each other to effectively handle time and priorities, and don't micromanage. We want people to have the space to think for themselves, while feeling supported by their team.

**Technologies We Use**

It doesn’t matter what languages you know when you join us, but it does matter that you can write clean, effective code and learn new languages quickly. Our software is constantly evolving, so we need engineers who can do the same. Alongside peers that bring diverse experience - whether you’re a former university TA, switched to CS recently, or are a hackathon enthusiast — you'll build your skills to apply the best technology to solve a given problem. Right now, we use:

• Varying languages, including Java and Go for backend and Typescript for frontend

• Open-source technologies like Cassandra, Spark, Elasticsearch, React, and Redux

• Industry-standard build tooling, including Gradle and GitHub

### What We Value

* Ability to communicate and collaborate with a variety of individuals, including engineers, users and non-technical team members.
* Willingness to learn and make decisions independently, and the ability to ask questions when needed.
* Active US Security clearance, or eligibility and willingness to obtain a US Security clearance.

### What We Require

* Engineering background in fields such as Computer Science, Mathematics, Software Engineering, and Physics.
* Familiarity with data structures, storage systems, cloud infrastructure, front-end frameworks, and other technical tools.
* Experience coding in programming languages, such as Java, C++, Python, JavaScript, or similar languages.
* Must be planning on graduating in 2028. This should be your final internship before graduating.

### To apply, please submit the following:

* An updated resume / CV - please do so in PDF format.
* Thoughtful responses to our application questions.

**Salary**

The estimated salary range for this position is estimated to be $10,500/month. Further note that total compensation for this position will be determined by each individual’s relevant qualifications, work experience, skills, and other factors. This estimate excludes the value of any benefits offered; and the potential future value of any long-term incentives.

**Life at Palantir**

We want every Palantirian to achieve their best outcomes, that’s why we celebrate individuals’ strengths, skills, and interests, from your first interview to your longterm growth, rather than rely on traditional career ladders. Paying attention to the needs of our community enables us to optimize our opportunities to grow and helps ensure many pathways to success at Palantir. Promoting health and well-being across all areas of Palantirians’ lives is just one of the ways we’re investing in our community. Learn more at [Life at Palantir](https://www.palantir.com/careers/life-at-palantir/) and note that our offerings may vary by region.

In keeping consistent with Palantir’s values and culture, we believe employees are “better together” and in-person work affords the opportunity for more creative outcomes. Therefore, we encourage employees to work from our offices to foster connectivity and innovation. Many teams do offer hybrid options (WFH a day or two a week), allowing our employees to strike the right trade-off for their personal productivity. Based on business need, there are a few roles that allow for “Remote” work on an exceptional basis. If you are applying for one of these roles, you must work from the state in which you are employed. If the posting is specified as Onsite, you are required to work from an office.

If you want to empower the world's most important institutions, you belong here. Palantir values excellence regardless of background. ## About the position

At OPSWAT, we're building cutting-edge solutions that protect the world's critical infrastructure. You will play a pivotal role in shaping the future of our OESIS Framework platform with cloud solution integrations.

This role owns the architecture and implementation of the SDK's core integration layer - the code that talks to cloud-based Endpoint Device Management frameworks such as CrowdStrike Falcon, Microsoft Graph/Intune, JAMF Pro and future device management APIs, and that packages the result as native binaries our customers embed directly into their own cloud products.

It is also the technical anchor of a small pod. You set the direction the other two engineers build against: the internal data contract, the auth-token interface, and the SDK's external API surface and versioning strategy.

## What you will be doing

Architect a unified, extensible integration framework that normalizes disparate vendor REST APIs: differing pagination models, rate limits and response schemas into one consistent internal interface

Design and build the SDK as native, cross-platform binaries (Windows, macOS, Linux) with a clean external API and header surface suitable for embedding into third-party customer products

Build and maintain connector modules for Endpoint Device Management frameworks (CrowdStrike Falcon API, Microsoft Graph/Intune API, JAMF Pro API), with an extension pattern for adding future platforms such as Workspace ONE and Kandji

Implement resilient request handling per vendor: retry and backoff, rate-limit compliance, partial-failure recovery, and API version migrations

Define SDK packaging, distribution and versioning strategy: ABI/API compatibility, semantic versioning, installer and package formats

Own the SDK's public developer documentation and the reference implementation used by partner and customer integration teams

Lead technical design reviews across the pod, and make the final call on the internal data contract and the auth-token interface shared with the Data and Authentication engineers

## What we need from you

4+ years of professional software engineering experience, including 3+ years building or deeply integrating with REST APIs at production scale

Strong experience in a systems or compiled language: Go, Rust, C/C++ or similar producing native, cross-platform artifacts for Windows, macOS and Linux

A track record designing SDKs or libraries consumed by external developers or OEM partners, not only internal services

Strong grasp of API contract design: semantic versioning, backward compatibility, deprecation strategy

Experience with CI/CD pipelines producing multi-platform binary artifacts

Ability to write clear technical design documents and drive a design review to a decision

Professional working proficiency in written and spoken English

## It would be nice if you had

Experience with ABI stability and cross-language bindings (C FFI, cgo, PyO3 or similar) for SDKs consumed from more than one language

Background in cybersecurity, endpoint security, or unified endpoint management (UEM)

Familiarity with Zero Trust Network Access (ZTNA) and device posture or compliance

Familiarity with regulatory compliance frameworks such as PCI-DSS, SOX or HIPAA

Hands-on experience with at least one of: CrowdStrike Falcon API, Microsoft Graph API, or JAMF Pro API or a comparable UEM, EDR or MDM API

Prior experience leading a small engineering pod of two to four people

Open-source contributions to SDK, networking or API client projects

You'll be part of a mission-driven OESIS Framework team that values innovation, collaboration and continuous development. Together, we're building SDK technology that makes a difference.

What We Value at Robinhood

## Insane Customer Focus

![](https://v.fastcdn.co/u/62ba1c13/65610225-0-Insane-Customer-Focu.svg)

## Insane Customer Focus

Our customers are why we exist. We listen to them, design for their needs, and aim to make our user
experience elegant and intuitive.

We put what's best for customers at the center of decision-making, bringing them the best in technology
coupled with real value. When there are customer pain points, we fix them quickly.

## High Performance

![](https://v.fastcdn.co/u/62ba1c13/65610226-0-High-Performance-Alt.svg)

## High Performance

We operate with extreme urgency. We push for progress without compromising quality-and when something is
broken, we fix it. We're driven by impact and pride ourselves in our ability to be nimble and quickly
adjust our strategy when presented with new information. Friction and obstacles don't deter us from
pursuing what's truly important.

## Safety Always

![](https://v.fastcdn.co/u/62ba1c13/65610221-0-Safety-Always.svg)

## Safety Always

Trust is hard earned and easily lost. We take responsibility for our customers' finances seriously. We
are compliant, approach risks thoughtfully, and never compromise trust for speed.

## One Robinhood

![](https://v.fastcdn.co/u/62ba1c13/65610223-0-One-Robinhood.svg)

## One Robinhood

We're all invested in the same mission. We earn each other's trust through honesty, inclusion, and
respect - because finger-pointing never does the trick. We invite contrary perspectives, support each
other, and debate with energy and kindness. Once decisions are made, we move in unison with ownership and
accountability, powered by the thrill of building something great together.

## Participation is Power

![](https://v.fastcdn.co/u/62ba1c13/65610222-0-Participation-is-Pow.svg)

## Participation is Power

We level the playing field. We started a movement, breaking barriers so everyone—not just the wealthy—can
access the financial system. The elites always find a way to get nicer things, which means our job to
"democratize finance for all" may never be complete — which is what makes it so fun.

## First-Principles Thinking

![](https://v.fastcdn.co/u/62ba1c13/65610227-0-First-Principles-Thi.svg)

## First-Principles Thinking

When we want to lead, we lead. We're innovators and problem solvers. Rather than iterating on the past,
we start from first principles, questioning assumptions and finding creative solutions from square one. We
use data, empirical truth, and experiments to inform decisions. Our bold bets often make us a first mover,
and we do what's right for customers - even if it hasn't been done before.

## Lean and Disciplined

![](https://v.fastcdn.co/u/62ba1c13/65610224-0-Lean-and-Disciplined.svg)

## Lean and Disciplined

We do more with less. Constraint drives us to innovate through scalable technology-not excess resources.
We set ambitious goals, benchmark performance, and weigh trade offs before changing course. We respect
each other's time by reducing toil and bureaucracy. And by keeping costs low and efficiency high, we
deliver exceptional value customers can't find anywhere else.
